briefings.title: 2026 Brookfield Affiliates Investor Day: Fireside Chat with Bruce Flatt and Howard Marks
briefings.tldr: Brookfield CEO Bruce Flatt and Oaktree Co-Chair Howard Marks discussed the evolution and resilience of private alternative asset management, emphasizing an ownership mentality, rigorous downside protection, and the strategic advantages of deploying capital counter-cyclically during market dislocations.

briefings.title: Qatar, Brookfield on Trade, Investment and Competition

people.name: Faisal bin Thani bin Faisal Al-Thani

briefings.tldr: Despite global uncertainties and regional instability, Qatar continues to maintain strong GDP growth and attract record foreign investment, while partnerships like Brookfield and the Qatar Investment Authority are scaling up local AI infrastructure and energy-to-compute projects.

briefings.title: Brookfield's Bruce Flatt discusses NVIDIA strategic partnership on CNBC
briefings.tldr: NVIDIA has formed a strategic coalition with six major Wall Street financial institutions—Goldman Sachs, BlackRock, Blackstone, KKR, Apollo, and Brookfield—to secure over $500 billion in third-party, independent financing for the global AI infrastructure buildout.
